question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is '**boosting**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses how food and social interaction contribute to well-being.
 
• The appropriate verb should indicate an improvement in mood.
 
• "**Boosting**" fits well as it means to enhance or improve, which aligns with the idea of food and conversation uplifting one's mood.
 
• Other options ("**lowering**", "**depreciating**", "**falling**") do not convey the idea of a positive impact on mood.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Lowering (कम करना): "Lowering" means reducing or decreasing, which does not fit the context of improving mood.
 
• Depreciating (मूल्य में कमी): "Depreciating" refers to a decrease in value, which is unrelated to mood improvement.
 
• Falling (गिरना): "Falling" indicates a decline or drop, which does not align with the idea of uplifting mood.
